"""Verification harness: load the airline DB, instantiate the EDITED AirlineTools
from ./tools/tools.py, and expose helpers to test guards on real data.

Run with the tau2 venv:
  /vol/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/venv/bin/python3 verify_harness.py
"""
import importlib.util, os

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
TOOLS_PATH = os.path.join(HERE, "tools", "tools.py")
DB_PATH = "/vol/home/skillberry/.cache/capevolve-ci/tau2-bench/data/tau2/domains/airline/db.json"

from tau2.domains.airline.data_model import FlightDB


def load_tools():
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("edited_tools", TOOLS_PATH)
    mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)
    db = FlightDB.load(DB_PATH)
    return mod.AirlineTools(db), db, mod


def fresh():
    return load_tools()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    t, db, mod = load_tools()
    print("loaded. #users", len(db.users), "#reservations", len(db.reservations))
